summary: Lasa Supergenerics Limited reported a net loss of ₹3,409.03 lakh for FY26, widening from the previous year's loss. Operations remain suspended following a fire incident in May 2025.

headline: Western Overseas signs Spain university deal
summary: Western Overseas Study Abroad Ltd has entered into an agreement with the University of Design, Innovation and Technology (UDIT) in Madrid, Spain, to recruit students for higher education programmes.

headline: Adarsh Plant Protect AGM: Shareholders approve MoA amendment
summary: Adarsh Plant Protect Limited concluded its 34th AGM on September 19, 2026. Shareholders approved the adoption of FY26 financials, reappointment of Mrs. Jyotika Patel, and amendments to the Memorandum of Association.

headline: Ramky Infrastructure submits revised FY26 annual report
summary: Ramky Infrastructure Limited has submitted a revised annual report for FY26 to BSE and NSE. The filing incorporates only cosmetic and editorial changes with no impact on material disclosures.

headline: Aadhar Housing Finance repays NCD principal and interest
summary: Aadhar Housing Finance confirmed timely payment of ₹90 lakh interest and full redemption of ₹10 crore principal on its non-convertible debentures on the respective due dates.

headline: Karnataka Bank promotes six officials to DGM cadre
summary: Karnataka Bank Ltd has promoted six Assistant General Managers to the Deputy General Manager cadre effective September 19, 2026, as per SEBI Regulation 30 disclosure.

headline: Aarcon Facilities FY26 results: Revenue down 69%
summary: Aarcon Facilities reported a sharp decline in FY26 revenue and net profit. The hospitality firm also flagged governance gaps, including non-compliant audit committees and unpaid listing fees.

headline: Shish Industries to approve merger scheme
summary: Shish Industries Ltd schedules board meeting on September 23, 2026, to consider amalgamation with two wholly owned subsidiaries. Trading window closes for designated persons.

headline: Likhitha Infrastructure FY26 Results: PAT down 42% to ₹400.2 crore
summary: Likhitha Infrastructure Limited reported a 42% decline in standalone PAT to ₹400.2 crore for FY26, driven by lower revenue from operations. The company secured a ₹510 crore international order post-year-end.

headline: Valson Industries holds 42nd AGM on Sep 19, 2026
summary: Valson Industries Limited concluded its 42nd Annual General Meeting on September 19, 2026. The meeting approved FY26 financials and re-appointed director Ankit Mutreja.

headline: SAIL Q1FY27 Results: Profit up 139% YoY
summary: Steel Authority of India reported a 139% YoY jump in Q1FY27 net profit to ₹1,636 crore, driven by higher sales prices. EBITDA rose to ₹4,356 crore with margins expanding to 16.7%. Debt-equity ratio improved to 0.54.

headline: Parmeshwar Metal AGM: Dividend declared, accounts adopted
summary: Parmeshwar Metal Limited concluded its 10th AGM on September 19, 2026. The company declared a final dividend of ₹1.25 per share for FY26 and adopted audited financial statements.

headline: Poddar Pigments signs US distribution deal
summary: Poddar Pigments Ltd partners with Sukano Polymers Corp USA for exclusive sales of Single Pigment Dispersion portfolio across US, Canada, and Latin America effective September 2026.

headline: Silverline Technologies updates website URL
summary: Silverline Technologies Limited has notified BSE of a change in its official website address. The new URL replaces the previous domain for all stakeholder communications.

headline: Arco Leasing shifts registered office to Borivali
summary: Arco Leasing Ltd board approves shifting of registered office from Andheri to Borivali East, Mumbai. The move takes effect on September 21, 2026.

headline: Manaksia Coated Metals AGM passes key resolutions
summary: Manaksia Coated Metals & Industries Ltd shareholders approved FY26 financials, a ₹0.05 dividend, and director re-appointments at its 16th AGM held on September 3, 2026.

headline: SG Mart holds 41st AGM, approves board appointments
summary: SG Mart Limited held its 41st AGM on September 19, 2026, adopting FY26 financials and approving key director appointments. The meeting highlighted the company's transition to an integrated building materials platform.

headline: LGB Forge shareholders approve director appointment, MoA changes
summary: LGB Forge Ltd shareholders passed resolutions to appoint Arjun Parthasarathy as director and alter the company's Memorandum and Articles of Association via postal ballot.

headline: Ashika Global Securities AGM results
summary: Ashika Global Securities held its 33rd AGM on September 19, 2026. Shareholders approved a ₹1,000 crore QIP, FY26 financials, and a Re. 0.50 dividend.
